(1) the Houston transfer surface predicts over-all transfer, (2) the Houston transfer paradigm is not a necessary condition for the Osgood transfer surface, (3) the Houston transfer paradigms do not predict over-all transfer, and (4) the Osgood surface does not predict over-all transfers.

(a) the Osgood paradigm predicts over-all transfer, and the Houston paradigm does not; (b) the Houston paradigm predicts within-task transfer, and the Osgood does not; and (c) the Houston paradigm, but not the Osgood, predicts over-all similarity.
